messages:
Priya (CS): Quick heads-up — Pathfinder (renewal Q3) seeing tail latency spikes on long prompts (~+180ms p95). They're on hosted M3-large.
Joan (Eng-ML): Thanks — agree we should preempt. Suggest a staged compact-quant pilot (int8) with routing for non-sensitive paths. Need eval prompts.
Priya (CS): Sharing 100 anonymized prompts in the shared drive: https://drive.redwood/pathfinder/prompt-set. Target start: Tue 13:00 UTC canary 10%.
Ravi (Eng-SRE): I can add alerting and a temporary dashboard tile. Do we want auto-fallback to current model on quality regressions?
Joan (Eng-ML): Yes — fallback policy: if hallucination metric delta > 3% or error rate > 0.5% revert. Here's the quick config to use:
```yaml
routing:
  - match: "non-sensitive"
    route_to: pathfinder-compact-int8-v1
    weight: 0.10
fallback:
  revert_on:
    hallucination_delta: 0.03
    error_rate: 0.005
monitoring:
  metrics: [p95_latency, token_cost, hallucination_rate]
``` 
Kevin (Ops): Cost note — expect ~30-40% token cost reduction for routed traffic. We'll need a short quota bump for canary; @Tyler can you approve?
Tyler (CS-Manager): Approving quota bump for canary. Also copy renewal playbook: this proactive offer looks great for renewal conversation. :tada:
Priya (CS): I'll create an enablement doc for Pathfinder so they can opt to mark requests as sensitive/non-sensitive. Also will send the survey template to capture feedback after canary.
Joan (Eng-ML): We'll run the quant eval against the prompt set and post a quality report by Monday. Also suggest KV cache warm-up on rollout to reduce cold-start p90.
Ravi (Eng-SRE): OpsBot will start canary once model and route are configured. I'll provision a temporary tracer and token-level cost breakdown.
OpsBot: canary-deploy initiated for pathfinder-compact-int8-v1 — 10% traffic; canary id c-1729800000; start 2024-11-05T13:00:00Z
Priya (CS): Capturing actions: 1) Joan run eval + quality report (due Mon) 2) Ravi add dashboard & alerts 3) Kevin/Finance confirm cost delta 4) Tyler approve quota (done) 5) Priya send enablement + survey. Will sync Friday for readiness. :pray:
Joan (Eng-ML): Noted. Please include a small set (20) of high-risk prompts flagged by customer so we can validate worst-case behavior.
Priya (CS): Will request from customer and add to the drive. Thanks everyone!
